repository.name: Hopper-Solana-Zero-copy-State-Framework
repository.description: Hopper is a fast zero-copy Solana framework: write programs like Anchor or Quasar, while Hopper verifies the bytes before it casts them. Start with familiar account and context ergonomics, then opt into upgradeable state contracts, segment-level borrows, receipts, policy graphs, and schema manifests when the program needs that power.
